design_understanding: Two-stage design confirmed. STAGE 1 (this file) — Layman -> legal term -> section: pick ALL layman words/phrases from the user's question, convert every layman expression into legal terms, then map each legal term to verified section(s) via Laya choice questions where the mapping is ambiguous. One layman sentence may raise 2-4 issues and must be split into separate legal terms, each mapped independently. Negations in Stage 1 BLOCK sections (e.g. 'no divorce' blocks HMA 13/13B and gates HMA 24/27 on a pending proceeding) before Stage 2 ever sees them. Out-of-scope layman questions must escalate, never be forced onto a section. STAGE 2 (lane 3) — Recheck inside the article section: after Stage 1 picks sections, RECHECK each picked section against ALL its relations (prerequisites, exclusions/not_for, related_sections, guardrails, court, co-firing sections). A section failing recheck (wrong issue, missing prerequisite, divorce not asked, etc.) must be DROPPED with a reason, not kept. Examples: BNSS 144 firing must recheck HMA 24 vs 25 and PWDVA 20; Stridhan must recheck HMA 27 + BNS 316 together; custody must recheck welfare-of-the-child overriding the natural-guardian default; residence must recheck PWDVA 17+18+19+20 as a set.
